question: Which of these must the driver of a private (non-transport) vehicle carry?
options: Driving licence and pollution under control certificate, with registration and insurance certificates (or photocopies)
explanation: A private vehicle driver must carry the driving licence and PUC certificate, plus the registration and insurance certificates (photocopies are accepted).
